name: OpenClaw (Prebuilt Image)
author: team@cyra.systems
description: OpenClaw prebuilt-image variant. Uses ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest directly - no source clone, no build, no pnpm/Bun toolchain. The startup wrapper materialises a per-deployment openclaw.json from env vars so gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins includes the customer's reverse-proxy FQDN (OPENCLAW_PUBLIC_HOSTNAME). Set that variable to the exact hostname the browser shows (the Origin the proxy forwards) and the 'origin not allowed' error goes away on first boot.
startup: sh -c "echo  | base64 -d | node && exec node /app/openclaw.mjs gateway --bind ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_BIND} --port ${SERVER_PORT} --config ${OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# No build needed - the runtime image ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:latest
# already contains the built application. We only ensure the volume is
# owned by the runtime user (uid 1000 = `node` in the openclaw image).
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "openclaw prebuilt image - no build required" > /mnt/server/.installed
chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server || true

variables.name: Gateway Bind Mode
variables.description: Where the gateway listens. 'lan' = 0.0.0.0 (reachable via Wings port mapping). Use 'lan' for normal panel usage.

variables.name: Public Hostname (reverse-proxy FQDN)
variables.description: REQUIRED IF YOU USE A REVERSE PROXY. The exact hostname the browser shows in the address bar (e.g. customer1.openclaw.example.com). The browser's Origin header uses this; it must match an entry in allowedOrigins or you will see 'origin not allowed'. Leave blank if you only access via SERVER_IP:SERVER_PORT directly.

variables.name: Public Scheme
variables.description: Scheme of the reverse proxy. Use 'https' when the proxy terminates TLS, 'http' otherwise. The full origin (scheme://hostname) is added to allowedOrigins.

variables.name: Extra Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional full origins (scheme://host[:port]) to merge into gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins. Useful for staging domains, staff tools, or temporary debug origins. '*' is allowed but disables CORS protection.

variables.name: Config Path
variables.description: Where openclaw.json lives inside the container. Must be in /home/container so Pelican preserves it across restarts.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Token
variables.description: Bearer token required when the gateway binds beyond loopback. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Required for any non-loopback bind. Do NOT leave this blank in production.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Password (alt)
variables.description: Optional alternative to the token-based auth. Use either a token OR a password, not both.

variables.name: State Directory Override
variables.description: Optional override for the OpenClaw state directory.

variables.name: HOME
variables.description: Container HOME dir (set to the persistent volume so openclaw can write state).
